subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Playwright August Wilson grew up in Pittsburgh and studied drama at the University of Pittsburgh.
• Some of Wilson's best-known plays are set in Pittsburgh.
• Two such plays are Fences (1985) and The Piano Lesson (1987).
• Wilson's plays explore the experiences of African American families in urban communities.
prompt: The student wants to identify the setting of Wilson's play Fences. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Wilson, author of Fences, explored the experiences of African American families in his plays.
choices.B: Fences is set in Pittsburgh, where Wilson grew up.
choices.C: Among Wilson's best-known plays are Fences (1985) and The Piano Lesson (1987).
choices.D: Wilson studied drama at the University of Pittsburgh and set some of his plays in Pittsburgh.

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. This choice directly identifies the setting of Wilson's play Fences as Pittsburgh.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. This choice mentions that Fences is one of Wilson's best-known plays but doesn't state where it takes place.
